data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding (closing position at 31 Dec 2017) is taken from the Balance Sheet. The report images provided did not contain a clearly extractable gross movement in prior years (movement in prior year's provision) in a readable, unambiguous form, so no quantified prior-year development (gross) could be determined from the supplied scans. A gross claims development triangle appears present in the notes but individual cell values could not be reliably transcribed from the images.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as low-resolution scanned images. The Balance Sheet value for 'Claims outstanding' was legible (2017 comparative column = GBP 172,403,000 -> 172.403m) and used as opening reserves. However the specific gross prior-year movement (Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) could not be confidently read from the scanned notes or narrative; a claims development triangle appears to exist (page ~28) but individual triangle cells were not reliably extractable. As a result prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Gross written premium total (2018) was readable as GBP 154,875,000 -> 154.875m but the detailed gross premium by statutory class (segmental mix) could not be unambiguously transcribed from the images and is therefore omitted. If higher-resolution images or the original PDF are provided, the prior-year movement note, exact reserve movement text, the triangle cells and a full premium mix can be extracted.
